messages:
Lena: Heads up: release cut is blocked. Staging rollout failed during image unpack on 5/8 runners, deploy-bot auto-paused promo. Error looks like corrupted layer from registry cache.

DeployBot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot at 3411111111. Reason: registry-layer-truncation on service-api-staging. See https://ci.redwood/builds/9812 :no_entry_sign:

Tom: quick log excerpt from runner-7:
```
time=\"2026-03-22T14:02:09Z\" level=error msg=\"failed to unpack image: applying layer: unexpected EOF reading compressed data\"
Digest: sha256:baadf00d... layer: sha256:deadlayer123 size: expected=10485760 got=7340032
```

storage-bot: Registry metrics: edge-cache 499 responses increased ~15x in us-east-1 between 13:45-13:55 UTC. Storage team ticket ST-1439 created.

Lena: Looks like a bad layer upload or proxy serving truncated content. We have a 30m change window left. Options: 1) pin staging to last-good digest to unblock cut, 2) rebuild image + push new tag and wait for propagation, 3) force registry cache purge and re-promote (might not finish in time). Thoughts?

Tom: Rebuild+push will take ~8-12m, plus 5-10m for cache invalidation propagation. Pin is fastest. If we pin we should also kick the rebuild in parallel and then retarget.

EngOnCall: If we pin, ensure we document rollback steps and update release notes. Also toggle alerting for `image.unpack.errors` so SRE can watch.

CI-Runner-Bot: Command queued: `/ci retry builds/9812 --scope=image-unpack` (3 runners).

Tom: I can trigger a rebuild with `BUILD_CACHE=off` and `CHUNK_SIZE=4MB` to avoid multipart race. Kicking that off now.

Lena: Manual promote API: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=service-api --digest=sha256:goodbeef --reason=\"pin to last-known-good to meet release window\"` needs 2 approvals.

Tom: +1 to pin, I'll do the rebuild.

Lena: +1. @Tom can you also include `REGISTRY_VALIDATE=1` on the push so the upload verifies checksums?

Tom: yes pushing with verify. Starting push, progress: chunk 1/5 uploaded.

DeployBot: Promote request created: ID 9017. Waiting for 2 approvals.

EngOnCall: approved.

Lena: approved.

DeployBot: Promote executed: service-api (staging) -> sha256:goodbeef at 3411111259. Comment: pinned to known-good digest to unblock release.

Tom: Rebuild finished, pushed new digest sha256:feedface with `REGISTRY_VALIDATE=1`. Registry verify passed. Now kicking canary retarget after 6m smoke. Link: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/registry-verify/3344

CI-Runner-Bot: image-unpack retry jobs passed on the retried runners.

Lena: Timeline: pin now (T+0), smoke checks T+6m, retarget T+12-15m. If reupload verification fails, we keep pin and escalate to oncall-storage.

storage-bot: Storage team will run background integrity sweep for recent uploads and disable the faulty proxy node. Ticket ST-1439 assigned to @storage-team.

Tom: Follow-ups: 1) add `REGISTRY_VALIDATE` to CI push pipeline, 2) add artifact upload healthcheck, 3) investigate chunking defaults that may lead to partial writes. I'll own 1+2.

Lena: I'll add release note entry: \"Canary temporarily pinned to last-good image due to registry layer truncation; retarget scheduled after verified repush. See ST-1439.\" Will also add rollback playbook.

EngOnCall: Thanks. Unblock confirmed once deploybot finished. Please file a short postmortem and link to the storage ticket. :thumbsup:
